shortDescription: Sends a notification to a grove.io channel

options.name: channel_token
options.description: Token of the channel to post to.

options.name: message_content
options.description: Message content. The alias O(ignore:message) has been removed in community.general 4.0.0.

options.name: service
options.description: Name of the service (displayed as the "user" in the message).

options.name: url
options.description: Service URL for the web client.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
